CustomField.description:
Matched - Gemini successfully analyzed the document and found matching HDPE/Polymer keywords.
Checked - No Match - All supported files were analyzed successfully, but no HDPE/Polymer keywords were found.
No Supported Files - All attached files are in unsupported formats (e.g., XLS, ZIP, DOCX), so no documents could be analyzed.
Failed - Will Retry - A download error or Gemini timeout occurred. The record was not fully processed and will be retried in the next batch run.
Failed - No Documents - No child document records were found for the Tender.
Failed - Config Error - The required keyword configuration (Tender_Key_words_Final__mdt) could not be loaded.
Failed - Unexpected Error - An unexpected exception occurred while processing the Tender.
CustomField.label: Polymer HDPE Stage Check
